Junior Motion Designer/AI Creator

Bitmedia Labs Швидко Відповідає
до $1000
Продуктова компанія

Bitmedia Labs is an international product company founded in 2014. Today, we’re a team of 150+ specialists working globally, building products used by millions worldwide.

Our work spans two core areas:
• Game Development — browser-first games for global audiences, centered on reward-driven progression and long-term engagement.
• Digital Advertising — high-performance advertising and affiliate platforms across Web2 and Web3 markets.

We believe great products are built by people who take ownership — shaping direction, making decisions, and seeing their work turn into real impact. Now, we’re looking for a 2D Motion Designer / AI Creator to join the team and help us move our products forward.

Requirements:
• 1+ years of commercial experience in 2D Motion Design, with a strong portfolio or showreel;
• Confident Adobe After Effects skills;
• Good visual and Motion Design foundation, including composition, typography, animation principles, timing, and pacing;
• Basic video editing and compositing skills;
• Ability to understand a creative brief and translate it into an engaging motion solution;
• Experience working with footage, graphics, brand assets, and UGC;
• Basic understanding of short-form social media and digital advertising content;
• Interest in AI-assisted creative production and willingness to develop AI Creation skills;
• Ability to work with feedback, learn quickly, and collaborate effectively with Design and Marketing;
• English — B1+ for reading briefs, writing short updates, and discussing day-to-day tasks.

Responsibilities:
• Create advertising and promotional motion videos for social media, including Reels, TikTok, Shorts, Stories, and feed ads;
• Analyze briefs, communication goals, audience information, references, and project requirements before starting production;
• Research relevant references, trends, and visual approaches when needed;
• Contribute to creative concepts and explore solutions through sketching, storyboards, styleframes, or animatics when appropriate;
• Create 2D animations in Adobe After Effects, including typography, transitions, kinetic text, basic VFX, and logo/product animations;
• Edit and adapt existing footage, brand assets, graphics, and UGC into engaging social media creatives;
• Use AI tools to generate or enhance assets and video fragments and integrate them into Motion Design and video production workflows;
• Iterate creatives based on briefs, feedback, creative direction, and brand requirements;
• Adapt creatives and prepare multiple versions for different channels and placements, including 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9;
• Prepare and export final files for publishing according to technical requirements;
• Meet agreed deadlines and communicate progress, blockers, and changes early;
• Maintain organized project files and follow established brand guidelines;
• Learn from feedback and available performance data to continuously improve future creatives.

Nice to Have:
• Experience with AI image or video generation tools and generative workflows such as image-to-video, video-to-video, or AI-assisted editing;
• Experience creating advertising or performance marketing creatives;
• Experience working with gaming, digital entertainment, or similar consumer products;
• Interest in gaming and the gaming industry;
• Experience with character, illustration, product, or UI animation;
• Basic understanding of sound design and audio synchronization;
• Interest in creative performance metrics and using data to improve creative decisions;
• Experience with additional Adobe Creative Suite tools;
• English — B2+.

Hiring process:
• Intro call with a Recruiter — Test task — Technical Interview — Сollection of recommendations — Offer.

Why join Bitmedia Labs?
We care about what we build — and about the people who build it. Our teams work closely together, share responsibility for the product, and support each other in everyday challenges.

As part of the team, you’ll have:
• Professional growth through products operating at global scale;
• The opportunity to experiment, bring ideas to life, and influence product decisions;
• Collaboration with strong, experienced teammates who value quality and teamwork.

We also support you with:
• Flexible schedule and the option to work remotely or from our hubs in Kyiv, Warsaw, and Berlin;
• Competitive compensation, regular performance reviews, paid vacation, sick leave, and public holidays;
• Modern Apple equipment and thoughtful corporate gifts for holidays and personal milestones;
• Support for your growth: courses, workshops, and conferences.

Through our charity foundation Bit Spilka, led by volunteers from our team, we support the military, medics, and civilians across Ukraine — delivering over $500,000 in aid to date. Here your work also drives social impact, and you can also join our volunteer initiatives.

If this resonates with you — send your CV and join us.
Let’s foster the world together!
